svg.title: Hilbert trace of the modular genus field of X₀(N) and its 2-D shadow
svg.desc: An animated, script-free diagram. The one-dimensional sequence of genera of the modular curves X0(N), for N from 1 upward, is laid out along a Hilbert space-filling curve inside a square, so that consecutive levels stay adjacent. Each cell is coloured by its genus on a teal-to-red heat scale, forming a two-dimensional shadow of the sequence; cells of genus zero are ringed as holes, marking the levels where a Hauptmodul survives. The animation advances through Hilbert orders one to four, at each step halving the cell size and quadrupling the number of sampled levels, from four cells up to two hundred fifty-six. Landmarks flag N equal to eleven, the first level of positive genus; N equal to thirty-seven, the Fricke frontier; and N equal to seventy-one, the last supersingular prime. A synchronized timeline scrubber at the bottom marks the five chapters. All cell values are certified in the Lean file OggFrickeGenusScan; the layout and colours are a rendering only and assert nothing new.
svg.text: Hilbert trace of the modular genus field · X₀(N), N = 1 … 256
the 1-D genus sequence threaded on a space-filling curve; its 2-D shadow is the heat field; holes = genus 0
orders 1→4 step simple→complex by scaling ×½ and sampling ×4 each stage · data certified in OggFrickeGenusScan.lean

svg.text: A narrative manifold: the genus field of the modular tower X₀(N)
Order 1 — the coarsest trace: 4 levels, a single fold
Order 2 — scale down ×½, sample ×4: the field of 16 levels
Order 3 — 64 levels; the genus-0 holes ring themselves in
Order 4 — 256 cells; N>200 fade to voids past the certified scan
The whole shadow: a genus manifold threaded by one Hilbert geodesic
Hilbert d2xy bijection · genus-0 holes = surviving-Hauptmodul levels · frontier at N=37 (well below 71) · a rendering of certified data
